snippet.title: Conan Exiles Enhanced –  Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
The FREE game update Conan Exiles Enhanced is officially live on Steam, bringing the most dramatic visual and technical overhaul to the survival hit since its launch eight years ago.  

Arriving just ahead of the game’s May 8 anniversary, the Enhanced edition is a gift to the millions of Conan Exiles players around the world.
